decision_snapshot_source: PACS-Full replay before committing its selected plan

definitions.mean_die_utilization_percent: Executed NAND array time divided by total Die time across the complete replay.
definitions.mean_tsu_queue_length_per_die: Time weighted TSU occupancy per Die, including all flash transaction types.
definitions.mean_tsu_write_wait_us: Time from TSU submission to command dispatch for user write page transactions.
definitions.write_load_snapshot: At entry of the complete host write into address translation, before allocation. The common eligible Die pool uses CWDP Die indices with at least one writable Plane.
definitions.all_candidate_dies_idle_percent: No active command or queued flash transactions on any eligible Die.
definitions.die_load_gap_below_460us_percent: Max minus min of predicted Die ready time on the common pool, strictly below 460 us.
definitions.cross_channel_requests_percent: Share of successfully placed write requests with at least one page on a Channel different from the CWDP target.
